cards.name: cover
cards.headline:
The letter said
Wednesday.
I found it on Thursday.

cards.name: snap
cards.headline: Take a photo of the letter. Or pick the screenshot.

cards.name: forward
cards.headline: Or forward the school emails to your own address.

cards.name: the-week
cards.headline: It lands on the right day. Weekly ones come back.

cards.name: their-week
cards.headline: And on their week, in their own app.

cards.name: the-night-before
cards.headline: A reminder the night before. Another in the morning.
cards.body: We keep the reminders, never the emails. Nobody reads your inbox.

cards.name: ask
cards.save: Save it for the next letter in the book bag.
cards.send: Send it to whoever does the school run.
